chapters.title: A River of Receipts
chapters.blurb: A billion tab-delimited receipts a month pour into the object store, and one precise question waits at the bottom.

chapters.title: MapReduce, Watched
chapters.blurb: The two-step MapReduce runs on real rows: filter the week, key by category, sum, flip the key, and the sort comes free.

chapters.title: Serving the Leaderboard
chapters.blurb: The leaderboard lands in the sales rank table, one REST call reads it back, and a memory cache absorbs forty thousand reads a second.
